title: Opposite Pairs · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Opposite Pairs · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose three common words with clear opposites. The lead gives an opposite for each word. The group agrees all three pairs are opposites. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Opposite Pairs, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group agrees all three pairs are opposites.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group agrees all three pairs are opposites.
